title: E-GRV-0044: the standard quadrupole strain formula h = (2G/r) Qddot is internally consistent: numerical exponent...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0044 in the gravity arena: the standard quadrupole strain formula h = (2G/r) Qddot is internally consistent: numerical exponent extraction on the stated formula recovers $G^1 r^{-1}$ omega^2 $a^2 \mu ^1$ exactly (a dimensional-analysis check of the formula, not a measurement of substrate radiation), and the same extraction on a dipole formula h = (2G/r) Ddot gives omega^1 $a^1$, so the extraction machinery discriminates quadrupole from dipole scaling.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
